I actually have a number of friends who went into journalism. While I'm sure they have their own opinions on issues, what they really seem to care about is just getting the facts right. They hope to break a big story, which would help their career. But they also seem to really believe journalism is important because an informed public is a pretty basic feature of a democracy. They're not sitting around plotting how to manipulate people. They're not getting orders from any secret deep state cabal that controls the media.

And actually, the media isn't as concentrated as people often think. NBC, Fox, CBS, AP, ABC, Reuters, CNN, Bloomberg, NPR, Washington Post, NYT, USA Today, McClatchy, Politico, The Hill, The Atlantic -- these are all owned by different companies.
